description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
